class.name: EventInstance
class.description: Provides access to an FMOD event instance, including properties, playback etc. See: https://www.fmod.com/docs/2.03/api/studio-api-eventinstance.html

method.name: start
method.description: Starts playback of the event instance.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback of the event instance.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Gets the virtual position of the event instance.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the virtual position of the event instance.

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Gets the virtual velocity of the event instance.

method.name: set_velocity
method.description: Sets the virtual velocity of the event instance.

method.name: get_rotation
method.description: Gets the rotation of the event instance.

method.name: set_rotation
method.description: Sets the rotation of the event instance.

method.name: get_parameters
method.description: Gets an array of all the parameter names this event has.

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: Gets the current value of the given parameter. Returns 0 if not found.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets the named parameter to the given value. The value can be an integer, a float or a string corresponding to a valid label value.

members.member: The current playback volume of the event instance.
The current position of the event instance.
The current velocity of the event instance.
